# ProValuer Commercial (www.provaluer.in)

> ProValuer Commercial is a premier institutional valuation firm and asset intelligence platform operating across India. Our licensed professionals are Government Approved under the Wealth Tax Act and Registered Valuers under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (IBBI).

## Practice Areas & Core Capabilities

### 1. Statutory & Government Practice — Government Approved Valuers
- **Canonical Authority Page:** https://www.provaluer.in/government-approved-valuers
- **Focus:** Government Approved Valuation, Property Valuation Expert Services, Wealth Tax Act Sec 34AB Appraisals, Income Tax Sec 50C/55A Defense, Visa Financial Solvency, Court & Matrimonial Valuations.
- **Client Base:** Property Owners, Taxpayers, Chartered Accountants, Legal Advocates, Family Offices, NRIs, and Visa Applicants.
- **Statutory Mandates:** Wealth Tax Act 1957 (Section 34AB), Income Tax Act 1961 (Sections 50C, 54, 55A, 56(2)(x)), Indian Evidence Act 1872 (Section 45), Family Courts Act 1984, Indian Succession Act 1925.
- **Core Valuation Metrics:** Fair Market Value (FMV), SRO Circle Rate Discrepancy Defense, Historical FMV as of April 1, 2001, Visa Liquid Net Worth.
- **Regional Footprint:** Hyderabad, Secunderabad, Telangana (HMDA, GHMC, Dharani, IGRS), Andhra Pradesh, and Nationwide coverage with 24-48 hours turnaround for standard appraisals.

### 2. Banking Practice — Collateral & Security Valuation
- **Canonical Service Page:** https://www.provaluer.in/services/bank-collateral-valuation
- **Focus:** Bank Collateral Valuation, Mortgage Security Due Diligence, Lenders' Independent Engineer (LIE) Services.
- **Client Base:** Nationalized PSU Banks (SBI, PNB, Canara Bank, BoB), Private Scheduled Commercial Banks (HDFC, ICICI, Axis), Foreign Banks, and Tier-1 NBFCs.
- **Statutory Mandates:** Companies Act 2013 (Section 247), Wealth Tax Act 1957 (Section 34AB), RBI Master Directions on Secured Lending, SARFAESI Act 2002 Reserve Price determinations.
- **Core Valuation Metrics:** Tripartite modeling: Fair Market Value (FMV), Realizable Value (RV with 10%-15% haircut), and Distress Sale Value (DSV with 20%-35% haircut for 90-day liquidation).
- **Asset Classes:** Commercial Office Towers, IT/ITeS Parks, Industrial Manufacturing Sheds, Warehousing & Logistics Hubs, Plant & Machinery, Special Economic Zones (SEZs).
- **Regional Footprint:** Deep operational presence in Hyderabad, Telangana (HMDA, GHMC, TSIIC industrial corridors), Andhra Pradesh, and South India with guaranteed 3-5 business days turnaround time.

### 3. Corporate Practice — Equity & Financial Assets
- **Focus:** Share Valuation & Net Worth Certification
- **Client Base:** Corporates, Institutional Investors, Family Offices, and High-Growth Startups.
- **Mandates:** Companies Act 2013 Section 247 compliance, FEMA cross-border equity pricing, Ind AS fair value measurement, and M&A share entitlement ratios.

### 4. Regulatory Practice — NCLT & Insolvency
- **Canonical Service Page:** https://www.provaluer.in/services/nclt-ibc-valuation
- **Focus:** CIRP Statutory Fair Value & Liquidation Value Appraisals, Regulation 27 Valuer Appointments, Section 30(2)(b) Distribution Floor Benchmarking, Forensic PUFE Economic Valuations.
- **Client Base:** Insolvency Professionals (IPs), Interim Resolution Professionals (IRPs), Resolution Professionals (RPs), Liquidators, and Committee of Creditors (CoC).
- **Statutory Mandates:** Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016 (IBC), Regulation 27 & 35 of IBBI (CIRP) Regulations 2016, Companies Act 2013 (Section 247), IBBI (Liquidation Process) Regulations 2016.
- **Core Valuation Metrics:** Regulation 2(1)(hb) Fair Value (Highest and Best Use arm's-length exchange), Regulation 2(1)(k) Liquidation Value (forced distress realization under statutory court timelines).
- **Asset Classes:** Land & Building (industrial parks, SEZs), Plant & Machinery (heavy continuous process, chemical, pharma, steel), Securities & Financial Assets, Intangibles & Avoidance Transactions (Sections 43, 45, 50, 66).
- **Regional Jurisdictions:** NCLT Hyderabad Bench, NCLT Bengaluru, NCLT Chennai, NCLT Amaravati, and Pan-India Benches with 30-45 day delivery SLA.

### 5. Technical Practice — Engineering & Industrial Assets
- **Canonical Service Page:** https://www.provaluer.in/services/plant-machinery-technical-valuation
- **Focus:** Plant & Machinery Technical Certification
- **Client Base:** Heavy Manufacturing, Infrastructure, SEZ Developers, and Energy Assets.
- **Mandates:** Physical asset tagging, remaining useful life (RUL) assessment, Depreciated Replacement Cost (DRC), salvage value estimation, and impairment reviews under Ind AS 36.
